newsitem.title: LATVIA: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 5.
newsitem.headline: LATVIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - MAY 5.

text.p: These were the noon headlines on Latvian state radio on Monday. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Five parliament commissions discussed the need to sign the convention on refugees, seen as a pre-condition for more visa-free travel arrangements with the Nordic and EU states.
- Farmers will continue regular protests if the government does not start taks on compensating for inflation and the creation of a state grain reserve that could influnce the price of grain.
- The cause of death of a Swedish professor who was an observer at the March local elections is now being determined after his body was found in a lake near the port town of Liepaja.
- From May 1, a border food hygiene inspectorate will start work.
